<reason>PRO made the cleaner vote: comparable waits are what make access real, and CON’s alternative still licenses a slower wheelchair product. CON’s scarcity and intra-disabled tradeoff hits were the strongest counters, especially after PRO said delay and coverage would be shared, but they did not neutralize the moving-benchmark clash or the 6-vs-25 two-tier test.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>The 6-vs-25 exchange: CON admitted it is a slower product, then defended the gap via coverage/affordability trades; that locked in two-tier service as CON’s live alternative.</best_rebuttal>
